title: Introduction to Unity
competency: Knows and can navigate the Unity editor interface;Understands basic scene management and project setup;Can add primitive 3D objects and manipulate transforms

title: Working with game objects and prefabs
competency: Understands the concepts of GameObjects and Components;Can create, modify, and instantiate Prefabs;Understands parent-child hierarchies and transformations

title: Working with materials and textures
competency: Understands the role of materials, textures, and shaders in Unity;Can create and apply custom Standard materials to 3D models;Knows how to configure albedo, smoothness, and normal maps

title: Creative lesson. Creating a prototype
competency: Combines 3D models, materials, and lighting to create an interactive scene;Builds and tests a playable game prototype;Knows how to organize assets and export a build

title: Getting started with terrain
competency: Knows how to create and configure Unity Terrain;Can sculpt terrain using raise, lower, and smooth tools;Understands heightmaps and terrain resolution settings

title: Terrain detailing
competency: Can apply texture layers to paint varied terrain surfaces;Knows how to add 3D trees, grass, and foliage details to terrain;Configures terrain wind zones and billboarding settings

title: Lighting settings
competency: Understands Directional, Point, Spot, and Area lights;Can configure ambient lighting, skyboxes, and environment reflections;Understands the basics of Realtime and Baked Global Illumination

title: Visual and Sound Effects
competency: Can create and configure Particle Systems for visual effects;Understands AudioSource, AudioListener, and AudioClip components;Knows how to implement 2D and 3D spatial sound

title: Introduction to the C# language
competency: Understands the role of C# scripts as MonoBehaviour components in Unity;Understands basic syntax, comments, and the Start and Update lifecycle methods;Can output messages using Debug.Log

title: Variables and data types
competency: Understands fundamental data types including int, float, string, and bool;Can declare, initialize, and modify public and private variables;Understands how serialized fields appear in the Unity Inspector

title: Object classes
competency: Understands the basics of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) classes and instances;Can create custom classes and instantiate objects in C#;Understands class members and encapsulation

title: Functions and methods
competency: Understands how to declare and call custom methods with parameters and return values;Knows how to write modular and reusable code logic;Understands built-in Unity callback methods

title: Conditional constructs
competency: Can use if, else if, else conditions and switch statements to control game logic;Understands comparison and logical operators;Applies conditional logic to handle game rules and player state

title: Player Interface
competency: Understands Unity UI system (Canvas, TextMeshPro, Image, Button, Slider);Can connect C# script events to UI elements;Understands UI anchoring, scaling, and responsive canvas setup

title: Modular development
competency: Understands principles of modular architecture and script separation of concerns;Can manage communication between different scripts using GetComponent and references;Implements clean code practices in game development

title: Introduction to animation
competency: Understands Unity's Animation and Animator windows;Can create basic keyframe animations for GameObject transform properties;Understands Animation Clips and Animator Controller state machines

title: Character animation. Part 1
competency: Understands 3D humanoid and generic rigs, avatars, and bone hierarchies;Can import rigged 3D character models and set up an Animator Controller;Understands how to configure Idle, Walk, and Run animation states

title: Character animation. Part 2
competency: Can create and configure Blend Trees for smooth character locomotion;Can trigger animation transitions using parameters (float, bool, trigger) via C# script;Understands animation transition conditions and exit times

title: Project completion Working with the Timeline
competency: Knows how to use Unity Timeline and Cinemachine for cinematic cutscenes;Can combine audio, animation, and activation tracks;Finalizes and polishes an animated sequence

title: Introduction to 2D Games
competency: Understands 2D game workflow in Unity, Sprite Renderer, and Sprite Editor;Can configure Sorting Layers, Order in Layer, and Orthographic camera;Understands 2D coordinate space and sprite settings

title: Creating a space shooter. Part 1
competency: Can implement 2D player movement and screen boundaries;Can create laser projectile prefabs and instantiate them via player input;Understands 2D Rigidbody and Collider components for physics

title: Creating a space shooter. Part 2
competency: Can implement enemy spawning systems using Coroutines;Handles 2D trigger collisions for player, enemy, and bullet damage;Understands basic health systems and explosion effects

title: Working with a 2D environment. Game release
competency: Implements score tracking, game over, and restart UI flows;Optimizes 2D sprite rendering and audio for game export;Builds and publishes the finalized 2D game

title: Introduction to the racing games genre
competency: Understands mechanics of 3D vehicle physics and racing games;Can set up a 3D vehicle model with Wheel Colliders;Implements basic motor torque, steering angle, and braking inputs

title: Creating obstacles. Physics engine
competency: Understands Rigidbody physics, Physic Materials (friction, bounciness), and collisions;Creates interactive track obstacles and checkpoints;Implements lap timing and trigger detection

title: Creating rivals with artificial intelligence
competency: Understands AI waypoint navigation systems and NavMesh for vehicles;Can implement AI logic to follow track waypoints and avoid obstacles;Tunes AI speed and steering behaviors for competitive gameplay

title: Recording a gameplay video
competency: Knows how to set up dynamic chase cameras using Cinemachine;Can record and capture high-quality gameplay footage;Evaluates game performance, polish, and presentation

title: Game in the RPG genre. Player's rotation and attack
competency: Implements top-down 2D player movement, rotation towards cursor, and melee/ranged attacks;Handles attack animations and weapon hitboxes;Understands character state management

title: Game in the RPG genre. Enemy's movement and attack
competency: Implements enemy AI behavior including detection range, chasing, and attacking;Handles damage calculations and enemy health states;Implements enemy attack cooldowns and feedback effects

title: Game in the RPG genre. Control of game level parameters
competency: Implements Game Manager to control level states, win/lose conditions, and waves;Manages item pickups, loot drops, and inventory systems;Connects gameplay events to HUD and combat text

title: Games in the RPG genre. Saving the player's progress. Leveling system
competency: Implements player leveling, experience points (XP), and stat upgrades;Knows how to save and load player data using PlayerPrefs or JSON serialization;Builds a persistent progression loop across game sessions

title: A Game Developer's Portfolio
competency: Consolidates all game development projects into a cohesive developer portfolio;Understands project packaging, documentation, and showcase best practices;Knows how to present technical skills, gameplay demos, and source code professionally
